name: StegBrowser Runtime Consumption
purpose: Execute the manifest-declared StegBrowser owned mirror route through the existing StegVerse Node -> Interlock -> InTr -> bounded lease -> EVENT_EPHEMERAL StegOS materialization path, then continue the governed two-round-trip transport lifecycle without creating a duplicate runtime, scheduler, WorkerCoordinator, credential path, external host dependency, or second-device dependency.
trigger: STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-MATERIALIZATION-REMEDIATION-001 is ACTIVE/CHECKED_OUT and its complete manifest is bound to COSV 40000100100000; STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-CONSUMPTION-001 remains retired historical operation lineage and is not reactivated
scope: one manifest-bound invocation for STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-MATERIALIZATION-REMEDIATION-001 / COSV 40000100100000 using the declared StegVerse-owned mirror route and the existing invocation-owned Node/Interlock/InTr/lease/EVENT_EPHEMERAL materialization architecture

historical_architecture_precedent.pattern: REGISTERED_STEGVERSE_NODE -> INTERLOCK -> INTR_MATERIALIZATION -> BOUNDED_LEASE -> EVENT_EPHEMERAL_RUNTIME -> EXECUTION_TIME_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_BINDING

reuse_instructions: Trigger once the applicable registered/profile-derived StegVerse Node Receipt #1 is available through node_genesis_receipt/STEGVERSE_NODE_GENESIS_RECEIPT. The manifest wrapper validates the exact declared route. The runner validates Receipt #1 with StegOS validate_node_genesis_receipt, binds manifest_sha256 + node_id + interlock_id + registration_receipt_sha256 + Goal + COSV into the invocation lease/state identity, materializes the EVENT_EPHEMERAL StegOS runtime, binds lease_id + runtime_id back to the same identity, and requires the A4 packet/receipt to preserve the exact same correlation before authentic ingress is accepted. No pre-existing online runtime, generic chat-session process host, external device, or endpoint/receiver discovery stage is permitted. Historical SV002 engineering evidence is architectural precedent only and may not promote current StegBrowser runtime predicates. Round Trip 1 ends with the returned records packet durably recorded for verification; Master Records/mirror processing then occurs between trips; Round Trip 2 returns from the mirror boundary through endpoint Interlock/InTr into the ecosystem. Source or CI state must never be promoted to runtime completion evidence.
